name: Kalmaegi
title: Typhoon Kalmaegi (Tino), November 2025
impact: Rapid intensification twice: before the Philippines and again over the South China Sea.
events:
A tropical depression forms east
of the Philippines on 31 Oct.

Rapid intensification: +35 kt in
24 hours (JTWC), with a compact core.

Landfall in Cebu. Up to 300 mm of
rain on wet ground: flash floods,
269 deaths in the Philippines.

Crosses Palawan into the South China
Sea and intensifies again: +41 kt
in 24 hours (JTWC).
